article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Jacob Ognacevic's 30 points led Lipscomb past Stetson 93-60 on Thursday night. Ognacevic had seven rebounds for the Bisons (18-8, 10-3 Atlantic Sun Conference). Will Pruitt scored 20 points. Gyasi Powell finished with 11 points and nine rebounds. Treyton Thompson led the way for the Hatters (7-19, 5-8) with 15 points. Mehki added 13 points and four assists for Stetson. NEXT UP Both teams next play Saturday. Lipscomb hosts FGCU and Stetson plays Austin Peay on the road. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
